view_issues: Table 1 overall unadjusted PR is 1.03 but the age-adjusted PR is 0.88, a reversal by age confounding. Some CIs look implausible: AI/AN unadjusted 0.97 (0.81–1.56); ever had COVID-19, 1.20 (1.06–1.96).
